fact_text: On 5 Oct 2026 the Pakistan market had no momentum and volumes were very thin, so the analyst saw quiet conditions as a chance to pick good stocks selectively.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Attock Petroleum's Rs 40 final dividend goes ex on 12 Oct 2026, the same day as POL's ex-dividend date.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: A power-sector dividend of Rs 5 per share also goes ex on 12 Oct 2026; the transcript does not name the company clearly.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: At about USD 4 billion of deficit a month, the trade deficit would reach roughly USD 60 billion in FY27; the analyst attributes the deficit mainly to oil import prices.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Oil prices drive a chain in which the trade deficit moves the exchange rate, the exchange rate feeds inflation, and inflation shapes the policy-rate decision.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Pakistan has widened its crude sourcing beyond Saudi Arab Light to WTI, Dubai and Abu Dhabi grades, and some African crude, which the analyst sees as a diversified energy mix.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Reports suggest Saudi Arabia may lower Arab Light prices to help importers such as Pakistan, and lower crude prices would keep imported inflation out of the economy.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Refinery uplift rose to about 3.2 million tonnes in the first quarter of FY27, a sign of stronger offtake that flowed into oil marketing.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Refiners are getting better ex-refinery prices and their margins look protected, with the analyst reading the government's levy structure as helping refinery profitability.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Petrol was about Rs 394 per litre on 5 Oct 2026 when the analyst checked the pump price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Of the petrol price, about Rs 80 per litre is the petroleum development levy, about Rs 5 is a climate-related levy, and about Rs 7.87 is the OMC margin.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: OMC sales volumes fell in September 2026 from August, with PSO and Attock Petroleum handling lower volumes even as refinery uplift rose.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Cement local dispatches rose slightly while export sales fell, with the analyst citing high sea freight charges and the regional situation as likely causes.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Cement local prices are firm at about Rs 1,500 to 1,600 per 50 kg bag, so local sales earn more per bag than exports.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Cement export prices are about USD 38 to 39 per tonne, which the analyst considers too low to make exports attractive except to earn foreign exchange and absorb capacity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Lucky Cement exports cement, as do DG Khan and Attock Cement, to absorb capacity and earn foreign exchange.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: In Punjab, Maple Leaf Cement and DG Khan are the large players in local cement sales, so growth in Punjab local sales benefits them most.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cherry Picking | Dividend Stocks & Fertilizer Sector | Midday Flash 5 Oct 2026' (YouTube, 2026-10-05)

fact_text: Fertilizer sales fell in the months before 5 Oct 2026 when they should have risen; the analyst expects urea sales to improve after the coming application season.

fact_text: The analyst keeps fertilizer stocks in a defensive category and says their conditions remain favourable, with Fatima and Engro cited as the main examples.

fact_text: Fatima Fertilizer makes nitro phosphate and CAN, so it can set its own pricing, unlike urea, which is regulated.

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer's inventory is being released gradually, and the analyst expects its third and fourth quarter EPS to improve.

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer normally declares its dividend with its September results, and the analyst expects a dividend from that announcement.

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer keeps a market share of about 52 to 54 percent, and the analyst expects its dividends to be better.
